messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to align on prioritization for the v1->v2 transition across the API surfaces: chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool/function-calling, and structured output. Major customer asks: stable embeddings vectors, no breaking structured JSON schemas, and deterministic tool-calls. Proposed approach: short compatibility shims + migration docs + per-surface launch criteria. Thoughts?
jonathan: +1. Suggest we enumerate per-surface risk and mitigation. For embeddings the main risk is vector drift -> NN mismatch. I think a compatibility mode that pins the model/tokenizer fingerprint per-tenant is needed. Implementation: routing flag + per-customer routing table. Need cost estimate (GPU + storage).
sarah: FYI enterprise-C asked for "vector parity" within ~1e-3 cosine and strict schema stability for structured outputs. They will only opt into migration if we provide conversion tooling and a validation harness.
ethan: For tool-calls: v2 widens function arg types and nesting. We can build a lightweight adapter that maps v1 flat args -> v2 typed schema. Low engineering risk. For chat/completions, expect behavior drift; plan: regression evals + holdback canary to detect semantic regressions on customer prompt sets.
anita: Proposed rollout timeline: Phase 0 (2 weeks): compatibility shims + internal tests; Phase 1 (1 month): customer beta opt-ins with conversion tooling; Phase 2 (2 months): staged cutovers by customer; Phase 3 (6 months): deprecate v1 public routes unless pinned via Dedicated contracts. Does that match infra capacity?
jonathan: Caveat — we can't keep dual-model serving for all hosted tenants long term. For Dedicated/Reserved we can allow indefinite pinning. For hosted we should allow pinned compatibility only for a defined retention window (e.g., 6-12 months) then require migration. I'll draft cost numbers.
maya: Suggested launch criteria (per-surface):
- Embeddings: mean cosine delta <= 1e-3 on customer eval set, no more than 1% NN rank flips for top-100;
- Structured output: schema validator pass rate >= 99% + sample diffs reviewed;
- Tool/function calling: adapter success rate >= 99.5% across beta customers;
- Chat/completions: latency delta <= 5%, error rate < 0.1%, regression alerts below threshold (eval score coverage >= 95%).
These need to be measurable and gated in the Console.
sarah: Also add operational gates: rollback path, automatic fallback to v1 route when > X% errors, and customer opt-out flag visible in Console. We should document SLOs during beta (expected higher error but SLA exempt).
ethan: Technical note: embeddings compatibility mode options: 1) Serve old model weights (exact parity) but higher infra cost, 2) Apply vector post-hoc transformation (calibration matrix) — cheaper but may not hit strict parity for complex models. Recommend option 1 for customers demanding strict parity, option 2 as default.
maya: For migration docs: include sample scripts (python + curl) that convert vectors, validate schema diffs, and run local rank checks. Example adapter snippet for tool-calls:
```
# v1->v2 adapter pseudo
def adapt_v1_to_v2(v1_payload):
    # flatten args -> typed dict
    return {"function": v1_payload["fn"], "args": parse_and_type(v1_payload.get("args",""))}
```
jonathan: Good. We should also add automated unit tests that assert backward compat on a set of canonical prompts and functions. Hook these into the rollout pipeline so any change that regresses compatibility fails gating.
anita: Customer comms: draft message to customers explaining the phased approach, opt-in beta, and migration support. We should schedule a webinar + office hours for top 10 customers during Phase 1.
deploy-bot: canary deployed: /v2-toolcall-adapter -> staging @ 2177779800
maya: Action items: @jonathan produce cost estimate and infra constraints (due EOD Thu); @ethan produce canonical eval sets for embeddings and chat (due next Tue); @anita draft customer comms + migration checklist (due next Fri). If no objections we'll lock timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
